none: PAS WMID-967C48: Roman coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Warwickshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete copper alloy Roman nummus probably of the House of Constantine (AD 307 to AD 361). Possibly VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP reverse type depicting two Victories standing holding wreath inscribed with VOT P R, or possibly VICTORIAE DD NN AVG ET CAE(S) reverse type depicting two Victories holding a wreath inscribed with VOT V MVLT X. Mint uncertain. Diameter: 19.8 mm. Thickness: 2.2 mm.…
